info.title: ApplyTrack API
info.description: Track job applications through a hiring pipeline, with reminders, statistics and optional AI resume tailoring. Authenticate with the `at_session` cookie set by `/v1/auth/login`, or send the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Errors use RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.

today.description: Today's date in the user's time zone

responseRate.description: Share of submitted applications that reached screening or later

offerRate.description: Share of submitted applications that reached an offer

weekly.description: Submissions per ISO week, 12 weeks, oldest first

StatsInput.description: Null rates mean there is not enough data (no submitted applications).

token.description: Session token; also set as the httpOnly `at_session` cookie

reason.description: Why AI is unavailable, when it is

usedToday.description: Requests in the last rolling 24 hours

post.summary: Move an application to another pipeline stage
post.description: Records a timeline event. Closed stages (accepted, rejected, withdrawn) can only be reopened to `applied`. The first move to a submitted stage sets `appliedOn`; the first move to `applied` also creates a follow-up reminder 7 days later.

occurredAt.description: When the change happened; defaults to now

post.summary: Generate AI resume suggestions for an application
post.description: Requires a saved resume and a job description on the application. Limited per user per rolling 24 hours. Failed provider calls do not count towards the limit.
